turns.customer: Random question, can you help me with my taxes? Also what breed should I get next, a corgi or a frenchie?
blocks:
Yes—I can help with **general tax questions** and organizing what to ask a tax professional, but I can’t replace personalized tax advice.

For the dog choice, my quick lean is **corgi if you want a more active companion and don’t mind regular shedding**; Pembrokes generally benefit from moderate daily exercise and shed quite a bit. ([akc.org](https://www.akc.org/dog-breeds/pembroke-welsh-corgi/?utm_source=openai)) **Frenchie if you prefer shorter walks**, but weigh the health considerations: French Bulldogs are short-nosed dogs and can be prone to breathing problems, with extra care needed around heat and exercise. ([vet.cornell.edu](https://www.vet.cornell.edu/departments-centers-and-institutes/riney-canine-health-center/canine-health-information/brachycephalic-obstructive-airway-syndrome-boas?utm_source=openai))

What matters most to you: activity level, shedding, health considerations, or something else?
